document: Form PENS.E/6-A - Election to Defer Payment (less than 5 years of contributory service)

chunks.heading: What form PENS.E/6-A is used for
chunks.text: Form PENS.E/6-A elects to defer payment of a withdrawal settlement for a period of 36 months after separation, for participants with less than 5 years of contributory service.

chunks.heading: Acknowledgements on form PENS.E/6-A
chunks.text: The participant confirms electing to defer payment under article 32 for 36 months, confirms having read articles 32 and 46 of the UNJSPF Regulations and the form's instructions, and understands that payment may be requested at any time during the 36-month period via form PENS.E/6-B.
